name: Otome no Ken to Himegoto Concerto
original_name: 乙女の剣と秘めごとコンチェルト
source:
After studying abroad​ in order to learn fencing, Utsugi Hinata returns to his home country Japan for the first time in several years, and is greeted at the airport by a woman named Nina Clione, Ginran Academy's principal and chairwoman.

Guided by Nina, Hinata is led to a school and becomes fascinated by the scene that is being unfolded there. Sparkling sword fight​s and girls covered in beautiful armors.

"This is "Cadenza," a match between the knights."
"At this school, we teach "Chivalry.​" Hinata-kun, would you like to teach fencing here?"

To evaluate his skilled in fencing for Nina, Hinata decides to experience "Cadenza" immediately. However, instead of a gorgeous armor he thought he would be wearing, what is prepared for him are a sightly lewd bodysuit and even a wig, Hinata is made to dress up like a girl.

It is only possible at the "Theater" of Ginran Academy for the 3D armor and sword in hand to be projected virtually using cutting-edge technology. 

There, he confronts a knight who is considered to be the strongest in the school, and wins.

"That girl, who on earth is she?"
"This girl is a transfer student who will be assigned as an assistant instructor starting tomorrow, a second-year student in the Knight Training Department, Unohana Hina-chan!"

Thus, Hinata, or Hina, in a place where the maidens gather, begins to live a double life​ as an instructor and a student while being dressed as a girl.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
为了学习西洋剑术而留学的空木日向，时隔数年首次回到日本。在机场迎接他的，是银兰学园的学园长兼理事长——妮娜·克里奥内。

在妮娜带领下，日向来到学园，被眼前的景象深深吸引。少女们身披华美铠甲，刀剑交锋，火花四溅。

“这就是‘舞斗’，骑士之间的比赛。”
“在这所学园，我们传授‘骑士道’。日向，你愿意在这里教剑术吗？”

为了让妮娜评估自己的剑术，日向决定立刻体验一场“舞斗”。然而，他原以为会穿上华丽铠甲，准备好的却是一件略显暴露的紧身衣，甚至还有假发。就这样，日向被打扮成了女孩子。

只有在银兰学园的“剧场”里，才能利用尖端技术，将立体铠甲与手中的剑虚拟投影出来。

在那里，他对上了号称学园最强的骑士，并取得了胜利。

“那个女孩，究竟是谁？”
“这位是明天起将担任助理教官的转学生，骑士养成科二年级——卯花阳菜！”

就这样，日向，或者说阳菜，在这所少女云集的学园里，开始了身着女装、兼任教官与学生的双重生活。

[译自[url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/#story]官方网站[/url]并经编辑]
